rewire_fixed_GJM01.definition: 4 LQP02 Q25, 4 fixed GJM01 Q80, 2 grounded IC variable C Q80, identical L graph and physical row as A7-04. Move one of four fixed GJM01 to a different circuit edge, 44 distinct selections, one local start each.
rewire_fixed_GJM01.optimizer: L-BFGS-B, at most 48 iterations, 4 frequency points/segment search, 31 points/segment screen

one_PCB_L.definition: Add one uncoupled PCB L Q12, 0.1 to 3.0 nH, zero chip area; check 15 unique 5-node edge locations; other components A7-04 as starting values, chip-PCB mutual coupling k=0.

stopband_sensitivity.subject: A7-04
stopband_sensitivity.method: centered finite difference of minima wrt each grounded IC-C; per-branch shift +/-0.005pF, 151 points per band segment; measured condition of 2x2 H2/H3 Jacobian

conclusion: Neither tested fixed-C rewiring nor one uncoupled PCB-L addition beat A7-04. Limited finite local starts do not establish topology performance limits.
limitations: All 44/15 trials use finite local optimization; new 35dB screen candidate counts are grid-only, not full continuum/EM/corner verified.
The sole dense-checked rewire was worse than A7-04, so no new official design best.
Adding mutually coupled PCB inductors or internal nodes has not been explored in this experiment.
Canonical cost=6 hard cap is not modified, cost=7 is an exploratory budget.
